role_voices.text_zh: 紅酒只是顏色誘人，滋味終究比不上鮮血。
role_voices.text_en: The color of red wine is enticing, yet the taste cannot be compared to blood.

role_voices.text_zh: 呵呵，這當然是紅酒，不是鮮血。
role_voices.text_en: Hehe, this is wine or course, not blood.

role_voices.text_zh: 把眼神收斂一點好嗎？還是說你想被我咬？
role_voices.text_en: Please restrain yourself. Or do you wish for me to bite you?

role_voices.text_zh: …不要玩弄我的耳朵。這是屬於女媧大人的。
role_voices.text_en: ...Don't play with my ears. These belong to Master Nüwa.

role_voices.text_zh: 紅色瞳孔很神祕嗎？你也被我的瞳孔吸引嗎？
role_voices.text_en: You think red eyes are mysterious? Are you intrigued by my eyes too?

role_voices.text_zh: 紅色瞳孔可是女媧大人賜與我的寶物。
role_voices.text_en: My red eyes are my greatest gift from Master Nüwa.

role_voices.text_zh: 與您一起喝下這杯美酒，能給我帶來多少醉意？
role_voices.text_en: How intoxicated will I get when I share this wine with you?

role_voices.text_zh: 這樣一直盯著我看，你能看穿我的內心嗎？
role_voices.text_en: You think you can peer into my heart if you stare at me like that?

role_voices.text_zh: 過去我把喜歡的對象變成眷屬，唯獨魔王大人征服了我♥
role_voices.text_en: I used to turn the people I like into familiars. Only you have been able to conquer me, Lord Archfiend♥
I can't accept this... Lady Nuwa...
The taste of blood... it's the best!
